findings.quote: Change the state value to below_horizon and click Set State .
findings.confusion: If Alex runs this after dark, sun.sun is probably already below_horizon. Setting the same value may not count as a state change, so the handler might not fire and no log lines appear. Alex would wonder whether the app is broken and would have to guess at a fix.
findings.suggestion: Tell Alex to set the state to above_horizon first, then to below_horizon, or to pick whichever value differs from the current one. Also note that light.porch must exist, otherwise the turn_on call logs an error.

summary: Alex can follow this page: the new terms (handler, dependency injection, D, states, async) are each explained where they first appear. The one likely stumble is the manual test. It can silently do nothing if sun.sun is already below_horizon, and Alex would have to work out why.
